comments.body: It seems to be pretty unique... Where I can find some quests ??

comments.author: Blake.C
comments.body:
The only easy quest to get this title is a merchant quest called "I want to drink this world dry!". Deliver 10 alcoholic trade goods to this woman in the tavern at Port Royal. Your need to have discovered Port Royal and 1 mil to enter if your not a player pirate. The type of alcoholic trade goods to deliver depends on where you took the quest from.

London - 10 Whiskey
Amsterdam - 10 Gin
St. Petersburg - 10 Vodka
Lisbon or Seville - 10 Sherry
Hangzhou - 10 Shochu
